query:
UPDATE job_runs SET
             last_finished_at = now(),
             last_succeeded_at = CASE WHEN $2 THEN now() ELSE last_succeeded_at END,
             last_error = $3,
             runs = runs + 1,
             failures_in_a_row = CASE WHEN $2 THEN 0 ELSE failures_in_a_row + 1 END
         WHERE job = $1
